Subject: Clarification on Document Submission Process

Dear Team,

I hope this email finds you well. I am writing to provide a brief clarification on our routine document submission process to ensure we are all on the same page.

For routine documents, please submit them directly to the designated email address by the 15th of each month. If the document needs to be reviewed by another team or department, allow an additional 7 business days from the submission date for processing. Please ensure all necessary approvals are obtained before sending.

Should you have any questions or require further clarification on this process, I invite you to reach out to me directly. Your feedback is valuable and helps us maintain an efficient workflow.

Thank you for your attention to this matter. I appreciate your cooperation and look forward to any questions you might have.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
[Your Position]
[Your Contact
